final: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS byte_rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS average_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(m.byte_rate) AS average_byte_rate, AVG(m.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(m.byte_rate - o.average_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE m.byte_rate > o.average_rate
